## What does this change?

<!-- e.g. adds 2 researchers, fixes an affiliation, adds a paper -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Every new or changed fact is supported by a public URL in `sources`.
- [ ] Titles and author lists are copied exactly from the source.
- [ ] No private contact data, citation counts, rankings or promotional wording.
- [ ] `last_verified` is set to the date I checked the sources.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` passes locally (CI also runs it).

The maintainer reviews pull requests every Saturday. Merging requires maintainer approval.
